identity_boundary: Relational working language only; no continuity or authority claim.

observed_failures.observed: A later read-only combined remote probe returned no attributable output and earned zero credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Run the isolated fresh live-remote probe and compare its scalar head with Tamar's exact final without replaying the successful canonical aggregate.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep live-remote equality probes isolated, scalar, attributable, and separately polled.

observed_failures.observed: The first grouped required-guidance read exceeded the attributable output window and could not prove every file through EOF.
observed_failures.recovery: Read every required skill, routing reference, state, and schema independently in bounded ranges through EOF.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not combine complete-read obligations into one output window.

observed_failures.observed: A whole-file render of Tamar's 288-entry closeout manifest truncated before EOF and earned no complete-manifest credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Read the manifest in bounded ordered chunks and independently verify every declared Git blob and size.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Count long manifest lines or entries first, then inspect bounded ranges and exact objects.

observed_failures.observed: The first source x1-manifest replay assumed git_clean_bytes, while the committed schema declares git_blob_bytes, so the attempt failed at zero credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Inspect the exact manifest keys and replay the declared git_blob and git_blob_bytes fields against commit-local Git objects.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Discover JSON keys before traversing or projecting an inherited manifest.

observed_failures.observed: A recursive receipt search across the full archive bank ran too long and was stopped after its exact search process was identified.
observed_failures.recovery: Use the authoritative receipt directory and exact final-head filename from the activation, then hash that literal path.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never search the whole archive bank when the owner, phase, receipt class, and head are known.

observed_failures.observed: A narrower but still recursive validation-root receipt search ran too long and was stopped without evidence credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Probe only the exact owner-phase external receipt directory and the committed source pointers.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Reduce receipt discovery to literal owner and phase paths before invoking content search.

observed_failures.observed: A raw text search matched the entire compact single-line 2,650-proposal index and truncated its output.
observed_failures.recovery: Parse the index object and query exact proposal title fields and bounded vocabulary counts.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Use schema-aware JSON parsing for compact ledgers instead of line-oriented raw rendering.

observed_failures.observed: The first grouped source-catalogue template render exceeded the useful output window and did not establish a complete read.
observed_failures.recovery: Locate section boundaries, then read only the required helper and schema sections in bounded attributable chunks.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Map long source files by definitions before selecting bounded ranges.

observed_failures.observed: A later combined catalogue, test, data, and builder read again exceeded the output window; only complete bounded subreads earned credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Read phase data and tests independently and inspect builder sections by exact function boundary.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not aggregate multiple long implementation templates into one tool result.

observed_failures.observed: A PowerShell foreach result was piped without first being materialized, triggering EmptyPipeElement before the intended hash receipt ran.
observed_failures.recovery: Assign the foreach output to a scalar collection, then pipe the completed collection to ConvertTo-Json.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize direct foreach output before any downstream PowerShell pipeline.

observed_failures.observed: A parallel large-worktree git status probe yielded and its wrapper retained no session handle or attributable output, so it earned no clean-state credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Use exact owner-path untracked and tracked-diff probes, or supervise and poll a single yielded status session through completion.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never discard nested command metadata when a large-worktree Git probe may yield.
